text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Solar capacity (MW; AC, 99th percentile) the fit of each monthly cut subtracts for rows after the cut. Pin: experiment 45's real-time vintage. As-of: experiment 129's fit on data before 2025-07-01, held forward. Hindsight: experiment 129's fit on data to 2026-07-31, one value for the season-year.'
text.tspan: Solar capacity (MW; AC, 99th percentile) the fit of each monthly cut subtracts for rows after the
cut. Pin: experiment 45's real-time vintage. As-of: experiment 129's fit on data before 2025-07-01,
held forward. Hindsight: experiment 129's fit on data to 2026-07-31, one value for the season-year.
